release_notes: Ban 0.0.17: them 3 bo loc chon nhieu dung ma cua cong thue — Trang thai hoa don (1-6), Ket qua kiem tra (0-8), Ky hieu mau so (1-9). Bam o loc de tich nhieu muc, nhan hien 'Tat ca' / ten muc / 'Da chon x/y muc', nut Xong de ap dung; khong tich gi = lay tat ca. Cot 'Trang thai CQT' hien ten thay vi ma (tooltip giu ma goc). Nut 'Xoa loc' xoa ca ba bo loc.
